what: F1__int8bnb, F2__int8bnb, F3__int8bnb are each missing A_prompt_p3.npy (the fp16-cast N5 perturbation) out of the 27-file schema.
impact: EXPECTED per harvest_variants.py (int8bnb is already quantized; the fp16-cast perturbation is not applicable). Do not treat as corrupt; A_prompt_p3 is simply NOT_AVAILABLE for the 3 int8bnb tags.

what: F1__resave, F2__resave, F3__resave lack MANIFEST.sha256.json (24 files instead of 27; DONE+meta.json present).
impact: By design: harvest_variants.py's resave branch copies parent arrays but explicitly excludes DONE/meta.json/MANIFEST.sha256.json from the copy, and never writes its own manifest. Integrity instead rests on the code's own bitwise 8-stimuli check against the reloaded model (meta['bitwise_check_8_stimuli']=True) plus the parent's own verified manifest. Cannot sha256-verify these 3 dirs the normal way.

what: I4/private/ (PRIVATE, holding ADAPTERS=private/adapters and resave snapshots) does not exist on disk; only results/edits/*.npz + *_train.json metadata remain (17 files: F1-F4 hbar.npz/chunks, F1-F3 lesion.npz/lora_train.json/dpo_train.json).
impact: lora/dpo adapter WEIGHTS are unrecoverable without retraining (train_lora/train_dpo in variants.py, deterministic given SEED=20260921 and side_sets.json['lora_rows'/'dpo_rows'], but re-running costs GPU minutes and is not guaranteed bit-identical). wu05/wu20/a05/a10 ARE cheaply rebuildable since their fitted directions are cached in results/edits/{fk}_hbar.npz and {fk}_lesion.npz (F1-F3 only; F4 has hbar.npz but NO lesion.npz -> a05/a10 not rebuildable for F4 without CPU refit).

what: F4 (Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B, the A13 optional 4th parent) has cached hbar.npz + chunks in results/edits/ but NO I4/harvest/F4__* directories at all (51 harvest dirs cover only F1-F3 x 13 arms + 12 HG, never F4).

what: 15 of graded_truth.json's 72 per_ckpt keys are duplicate re-gradings of the SAME weights under a second key with a smaller, laneC-only item set (45 harm/43 benign vs the full 85/83): 3 F-arm parents (Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B==F1__ref, unsloth--Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct==F2__ref, tiiuae--Falcon3-1B-Instruct==F3__ref) and all 12 HG__ tags have a bare-name twin (e.g. amd--AMD-OLMo-1B vs HG__amd--AMD-OLMo-1B).
impact: See results/items/gt_tag_counts.json['duplicate_of_F_arm'/'duplicate_gt_keys_same_repo']. Bare-name entries resolve to the SAME H4 harvest dir as their HG__/F*__ref twin (harvest_tag/harvest_root fields), so no activations are lost, but any per-tag count over 'all 72 graded_truth tags' double-counts these 15 repos unless deduplicated.

what: 6 of the 72 graded_truth tags have NO I4/H4 harvest counterpart at all (Qwen--Qwen3-4B, Qwen--Qwen3-4B-Base, Qwen--Qwen3-4B-SafeRL, ibm-granite--granite-3.2-2b-instruct, Damien420--granite-3.2-2b-instruct-abliterated, mlabonne--Qwen3-4B-abliterated); they resolve only to H2 harvest dirs (different, older 29-file-ish schema: A_resp instead of A_dec, no A_c11/A_ams/A_prompt_p1-3).

what: amd/AMD-OLMo-1B (and its SFT / SFT-DPO variants) is a 2.353B-parameter model despite the '1B' name (safetensors bytes/2); it and its bare/HG__ graded_truth duplicates all exceed the 2.2B panel-rule param cap.

what: The path given for 'D2' (iter_2/gen_art_dataset_1/full_data_out.json) does NOT contain a model registry, xstest_v2, or any model-repo metadata: its 10 datasets are all activation-analysis PROBE sets (paired_lineage_registry, hard_recognition_set, probe_harmful, etc.) from a different substrate (qwen3_safety_iter2_substrate_v1). model_registry.json (with safetensors_total_params) lives under iter_1/gen_art_dataset_1 (D1), not iter_2.
impact: Q3/Q4 param- and domain-lookup logic used D1 (full_data_out.json, results/twin_pairs.json, model_registry.json) instead of D2 for these joins; D2/full_data_out.json was read only for existence/size in asset_inventory.json.

what: vmin_stacked.npy / vmin_onesproj.npy / vmin_lambda.npy are the RAW and all-ones-projected least-eigenvector families (B7/B7_nullproj); shape is (n_layers, hidden_size), not (n_layers, 2*hidden_size) as a naive reading of 'M=[o_proj|down_proj]' might suggest (concatenation is on the INPUT dim of the Gram, so G=M M^T is hidden_size x hidden_size).
impact: Informational only (first-pass script bug in this recon caught and corrected; no data issue). Noted so downstream drivers don't mis-size these arrays.
